title: Talarico draws scrutiny for closed meet-and-greet with Muslim leaders
text:
By CP StaffThursday, October 22, 2026Democratic U.S. Senate candidate James Talarico speaks at an American Federation of Labor and Congress of Industrial Organizations rally at The Texas Gulf Coast Labor Federation on Oct. 21, 2026 in Houston, Texas. | Danielle Villasana/Getty Images
Democratic U.S. Senate candidate James Talarico has drawn scrutiny for recently participating in a meet-and-greet with Muslim community leaders, including an organizer whose coalition has participated in events with the Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR), which has been designated as a terrorist organization in Texas.
Read Full Article: https://www.christianpost.com/news/talarico-draws-scrutiny-for-meet-and-greet-with-muslim-leaders.html
